title: Father’s Day Gift Guide for Peace of Mind: Outdoor Cameras for Every Corner of the Yard
summary: Arlo's most popular outdoor cameras, explained.
body_markdown:
- **Unique and memorable:** Dad may only wear that new tie once or twice. A security camera will give him a vital tool that he’ll use for days and years to come.
- **Top-notch security:** The best outdoor security cameras for yards and surrounding areas provide all-day oversight and protection, giving dad the most priceless gift of all: peace of mind.
- **Protects investments:**[Arlo wireless cameras](https://us.arlo.com/collections/security-cameras) give dad a watchful eye on package deliveries, parked cars, or other valuables and keep would-be thieves at bay. And if anything does end up damaged or stolen, their Father’s Day security camera gift will give them a record they can provide to law enforcement or their insurance agency.
- **Built to last:** With a rugged design and swappable batteries, Arlo wireless security cameras are durable and built for the long haul.
